description:
Current resting bids and asks, best bid/ask, and spread for one exact CoinAPI spot instrument, such as COINBASE_SPOT_BTC_USD. Returns exchange and provider timestamps. Snapshot depth defaults to 20 levels per side and is capped at 200. A snapshot does not establish bid buildup over time; use get_orderbook_history. CoinAPI only (provider=coinapi). Does not start a stream or a collector.

[Access: pay 0.005 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

limit_levels.description: Maximum price levels on each side of the order book.

provider.description: Optional upstream override; omitted uses the existing server default.

symbol_id.description: Exact provider spot instrument identifier, including venue, SPOT, base, and quote.

name: get_orderbook
